purpose: Reject-only causal screen of R-Drop on the existing Qwen3-VL head before full five-fold training

selection_time_rationale.fold_0: largest positive fold effect in the category-routed parent analysis
selection_time_rationale.fold_3: largest adverse and recall-sensitive fold in the category-routed parent analysis

changed_factor: training objective only: alpha 1.0 symmetric KL between two dropout passes
calibration: Candidate Qwen3-VL ranks replace parent ranks only on folds 0 and 3; other folds remain parent; each tested fold threshold excludes that fold
limitations: Passing authorizes only a full five-fold cycle and new immutable manifest; it cannot accept, refit, package, or submit the candidate.
